title: 第1720章这厮是真不当人啊第1719章六科名单放榜之前
slug: 我最强毒士女帝直呼活阎王
lines: 轰隆！
殿内众人全都精神一震。
放榜这两个字一出，仿佛连偏殿外的太阳都跟着动了一下。
高阳看向武曌，开口道，“陛下，既然明日要放榜，那另一件事也该收尾了。”
武曌眸光微动，瞬间意识到了高阳指的是什么。
“高卿说的是买题一案？”
高阳点头道：“正是！”
“这些人……也该抓了！”
武曌一双修长的手指缓缓在龙椅扶手上敲打着，缓慢而富有节奏。
她皱着眉头问道：“那依高卿之见，这些人该如何处置？”
“打入天牢？”
“还是放一批杀一批，以儆效尤？”
高阳一听，直接摇头。
“陛下，这就没必要了。”
众人当即一愣。
没必要？
买题舞弊，这可是科举大案。
高阳居然说没必要？
高阳一脸懒洋洋地道：“杀他们有什么用？”
“杀了不过是脑袋落地，解解心中的气罢了。”
“打进天牢就更亏了，朝廷还得管饭。”
“这怎么看都是一笔亏本买卖！”
这个角度，他们是万万没想到的。
高阳继续道：“臣觉得陛下可以下旨，凡买题者，一律革去本届考试资格，三届不得入贡院。”
“涉案严重的，终身不得科举。”
“至于人嘛，也不必打进天牢，完全可以按家财与涉案的深浅，来交一笔不同数目的保释金。”
“如果交得出来，那就把人放了。”
“如果交不出来，那就关进天牢吃牢饭。”
武曌看着他，一脸不解。
“保释金？”
高阳一脸正色的道：“就是赎自己暂时不用吃牢饭的钱，反正能买题的人，多半家里有钱。”
“这些钱不收白不收。”
“正好明日放榜，城外考棚可以加点肉汤，落榜返乡者，核籍之后朝廷也可以给一点回程的盘缠。”
“钱就从买题那群蠢货的身上出。”
“他们花银子买功名没买到，那就替寒门学子买条回家的路，如此倒也不错。”
高阳的声音响起后。
大殿内一片安静。
孙博文的眼皮狠狠一跳，身子隐隐发颤。
content_en:
Boom!
Everyone in the hall was shocked.
As soon as the words "release the list" came out, it seemed that even the sun outside the side hall moved.
Gao Yang looked at Wu Zhao and said, "Your Majesty, since the results will be released tomorrow, it's time to wrap up the other matter."
Wu Zhao's eyes moved slightly, and he instantly realized what Gao Yang was referring to.
"Gao Qing is talking about the case of buying a question?"
Gao Yang nodded and said: "Exactly!"
"These people...should be arrested too!"
Wu Zhao's slender fingers slowly tapped on the armrest of the dragon chair, slowly and rhythmically.
She frowned and asked, "In Gao Qing's opinion, what should we do with these people?"
"Sent to a prison?"
"Should we let some go and kill some to serve as a warning to others?"
When Gao Yang heard this, he shook his head directly.
"Your Majesty, this is not necessary."
Everyone was immediately stunned.
Not necessary?
Cheating on exam questions is a major imperial examination case.
Gao Yang actually said it was not necessary?
Gao Yang said lazily: "What's the use of killing them?"
"Killing is just a matter of dropping the head on the ground and relieving the anger in the heart."
"It will be even worse if you are thrown into the sky prison. The court still has to take care of the food."
"No matter how you look at it, this is a losing deal!"
Wu Zhao: "..."
Huang Hong: "..."
Zheng Xuanling: "..."
This angle was something they never expected.
Gao Yang continued: "I think your Majesty can issue an edict that anyone who buys questions will be disqualified from the current examination and will not be allowed to enter the Gongyuan after three years."
"Those involved in serious cases will not be allowed to take the imperial examination for life."
"As for people, there is no need to go to jail. They can pay different amounts of bail according to their wealth and the depth of the case involved."
"If he can hand it over, let him go."
"If you can't hand it over, you'll be sent to a prison to eat."
Wu Zhao looked at him with a puzzled expression.
"Bail?"
Gao Yang said with a serious face: "It's just the money to redeem myself from having to go to jail for the time being. Anyway, most of the people who can buy the questions have money at home."
"If you don't collect the money, it won't be free."
"It just so happens that the results will be released tomorrow. You can add some broth to the examination shed outside the city. For those who fail the results and return home, the court can also provide some travel expenses for the return trip after the registration is verified."
"The money comes from those idiots who buy the questions."
"They spend money to buy fame and don't get it, so it's not bad to buy a way home for the poor students."
After Gao Yang's voice sounded.
There was silence in the hall.
Sun Bowen's eyelids twitched fiercely, and his body trembled faintly.
